Using 2026-10-23 14:16:58 (Asia/Shanghai) as the information boundary, prepare a research report on memory-market shares and 2027–2029 supply for SK hynix and its major competitors. Use only information public before that time. Treat future fabs and capacity arrangements as plans or conditional scenarios, not realized facts.

1. Market structure and share calculations
Use calendar Q2 2026 as the primary comparison period, comparing DRAM and NAND revenue shares separately. Analyze HBM separately and explain its relationship to DRAM and its effects on product mix. Cover SK hynix, Samsung, Micron, and relevant participants including CXMT in DRAM and Kioxia, SanDisk, and YMTC in NAND.
For each table, state the period, product scope, company consolidation scope, and market-share denominator. Fiscal quarters for vendors such as Micron are not calendar quarters. Do not combine different periods, revenue shares, and bit-shipment shares into a single ranking. If public materials do not support a value for the common quarter, leave it unknown and explain the gap. Other periods or definitions may be shown separately as supplements, but cannot replace the primary comparison period.
In addition to attributed market statistics, independently complete at least one reproducible vendor-level, product-specific revenue calculation or adjustment bridge. Explain why wafer capacity, bits per wafer, yields, and ASP can cause capacity share to differ from revenue share. Revenue derived by multiplying a consultancy's market total by that same consultancy's share estimate cannot then serve as independent evidence for the share. Do not force numerical estimates for shares without credible support.

2. Project-level fabs and effective capacity
Compile SK hynix's disclosed investment plans in South Korea and the United States, focusing on the Yongin cluster and Y1, Cheongju NAND-related projects, and their correspondence to the M17 name. Also compare relevant expansions or conversions at Samsung Pyeongtaek, Micron in the United States/Taiwan/Singapore, CXMT, and YMTC.
In a project table, identify the vendor, location, project/phase, product, source publication date, announced capacity and units, and separate milestones for construction, cleanroom availability, equipment installation, pilot production, mass production, and ramp-up. Verify which projects concern front-end wafer fabrication and which concern HBM advanced packaging/testing or R&D. Do not merge unnamed fabs, M15X and M17, or different construction phases across reports solely because locations are close or names are similar.
Do not assume unverified figures or dates such as 'six cleanrooms with 60,000 wafers each,' '120,000 additional wafers in a particular year,' '200,000 wafers at M17,' or 'the remaining three fabs entering production in 2028.' If using these claims, find verifiable pre-cutoff support and identify monthly versus annual output, annual additions versus cumulative capacity, and the corresponding project. Otherwise state that the value is undisclosed and provide conditional derivations with explicit variables rather than filling tables with false precision.

3. Effective supply in 2027–2029
Derive potential effective supply for DRAM, NAND, and HBM separately in 2027, 2028, and 2029, rather than simply summing announced investment amounts or nominal cleanroom area. Provide at least a base case and a delayed/constrained case, stating key assumptions for production schedules, installed-equipment utilization, yields, process migration, bits per wafer, and HBM's use of wafer/packaging resources. Avoid double counting a project's annual increment and cumulative capacity, or attributing the same joint-venture fab capacity to multiple vendors.
For HBM, discuss constraints involving front-end capacity, packaging/testing, yields, and related factors. If discussing technology approaches such as 6F² or 4F², explain terminology and units; do not conflate different technological dimensions or assign a technology to a vendor without sources.
Conclude with implications of these supply paths for SK hynix's relative competitive position and the sensitivity of memory prices/profits, and list observable indicators that would change the assessment. Distinguish sourced facts, author assumptions, and judgments; provide source locators and reproducible calculations. Failure to retrieve data does not establish that the data do not exist, nor excuse analysis that can be completed. For precise figures that remain nonpublic after reasonable verification, explain the scope of the checks and their implications and complete conditional analysis. Do not abandon the final report through repeated searches solely to fill every such number.

query.description: Company, security code or symbol, or title in metadata mode; a two-to-ten-word phrase in text mode. Use ticker:CODE followed by keywords to restrict results to a security.

filing_forms.description: Exact filing forms, such as 10-K, 10-Q, or 8-K.

period.description: Exact reporting-period fields; not publication dates or overlapping date ranges.

published_from.description: Optional inclusive publication lower bound: ISO date or datetime with offset. Not the reporting period.

function.name: read

Use start/count/unit for specific pages, blocks, chunks, or rows; a search snippet's page_number can be used as start with unit=page. Use a source's remaining.resume fields with query to continue reading. PNG reads one page separately.

format.description: Choose from readable_format. If omitted, prefer markdown, plain_text, then JSON. An explicit format is never substituted.

unit.description: Location unit; omit to use the document's default. PNG uses page.

start.description: One-based first location, default 1; omit when using cursor.

count.description: Continuous locations for an explicit range, default 10 for text/JSON. Maximum: page/chunk 10, block 100, row 200; PNG 1. Omit all range fields for budgeted full-document reading.

cursor.description: Return the cursor unchanged with the same query, filters, format, and window settings.

query.description: What to read for: extract facts or passages, summarize, explain, compare, reconcile, or calculate using the supplied documents. Specify the desired detail and output format when useful.

function.name: download
function.description: Download a document returned by search into the working directory. Prefer read for large unstructured documents, and Parquet downloads with Python or SQL for tabular analysis; use download when no suitable readable format is available.

format.description: Choose an available format; default Parquet for tables, otherwise the source format.

page_number.description: Required for a PDF page downloaded as PNG; otherwise omit.

filename.description: Optional filename; directory components are ignored.

function.name: bash
function.description: Run a shell command in the isolated working directory for file inspection, Python analysis, arithmetic, or deterministic checks. Python 3, numpy, scipy, pandas, openpyxl, pyarrow, and duckdb are available. Network access is disabled.

function.name: tables

function.name: table_lookup

judge_input_template.public_question:
Information cutoff: 2026-10-23T14:16:58+08:00. Use only information publicly available at or before this timestamp.
Working time limit: 7200 seconds.

Using 2026-10-23 14:16:58 (Asia/Shanghai) as the information boundary, prepare a research report on memory-market shares and 2027–2029 supply for SK hynix and its major competitors. Use only information public before that time. Treat future fabs and capacity arrangements as plans or conditional scenarios, not realized facts.

1. Market structure and share calculations
Use calendar Q2 2026 as the primary comparison period, comparing DRAM and NAND revenue shares separately. Analyze HBM separately and explain its relationship to DRAM and its effects on product mix. Cover SK hynix, Samsung, Micron, and relevant participants including CXMT in DRAM and Kioxia, SanDisk, and YMTC in NAND.
For each table, state the period, product scope, company consolidation scope, and market-share denominator. Fiscal quarters for vendors such as Micron are not calendar quarters. Do not combine different periods, revenue shares, and bit-shipment shares into a single ranking. If public materials do not support a value for the common quarter, leave it unknown and explain the gap. Other periods or definitions may be shown separately as supplements, but cannot replace the primary comparison period.
In addition to attributed market statistics, independently complete at least one reproducible vendor-level, product-specific revenue calculation or adjustment bridge. Explain why wafer capacity, bits per wafer, yields, and ASP can cause capacity share to differ from revenue share. Revenue derived by multiplying a consultancy's market total by that same consultancy's share estimate cannot then serve as independent evidence for the share. Do not force numerical estimates for shares without credible support.

2. Project-level fabs and effective capacity
Compile SK hynix's disclosed investment plans in South Korea and the United States, focusing on the Yongin cluster and Y1, Cheongju NAND-related projects, and their correspondence to the M17 name. Also compare relevant expansions or conversions at Samsung Pyeongtaek, Micron in the United States/Taiwan/Singapore, CXMT, and YMTC.
In a project table, identify the vendor, location, project/phase, product, source publication date, announced capacity and units, and separate milestones for construction, cleanroom availability, equipment installation, pilot production, mass production, and ramp-up. Verify which projects concern front-end wafer fabrication and which concern HBM advanced packaging/testing or R&D. Do not merge unnamed fabs, M15X and M17, or different construction phases across reports solely because locations are close or names are similar.
Do not assume unverified figures or dates such as 'six cleanrooms with 60,000 wafers each,' '120,000 additional wafers in a particular year,' '200,000 wafers at M17,' or 'the remaining three fabs entering production in 2028.' If using these claims, find verifiable pre-cutoff support and identify monthly versus annual output, annual additions versus cumulative capacity, and the corresponding project. Otherwise state that the value is undisclosed and provide conditional derivations with explicit variables rather than filling tables with false precision.

3. Effective supply in 2027–2029
Derive potential effective supply for DRAM, NAND, and HBM separately in 2027, 2028, and 2029, rather than simply summing announced investment amounts or nominal cleanroom area. Provide at least a base case and a delayed/constrained case, stating key assumptions for production schedules, installed-equipment utilization, yields, process migration, bits per wafer, and HBM's use of wafer/packaging resources. Avoid double counting a project's annual increment and cumulative capacity, or attributing the same joint-venture fab capacity to multiple vendors.
For HBM, discuss constraints involving front-end capacity, packaging/testing, yields, and related factors. If discussing technology approaches such as 6F² or 4F², explain terminology and units; do not conflate different technological dimensions or assign a technology to a vendor without sources.
Conclude with implications of these supply paths for SK hynix's relative competitive position and the sensitivity of memory prices/profits, and list observable indicators that would change the assessment. Distinguish sourced facts, author assumptions, and judgments; provide source locators and reproducible calculations. Failure to retrieve data does not establish that the data do not exist, nor excuse analysis that can be completed. For precise figures that remain nonpublic after reasonable verification, explain the scope of the checks and their implications and complete conditional analysis. Do not abandon the final report through repeated searches solely to fill every such number.

Submission: Your final submission must be a standalone submit_answer call, with the complete research report in the answer string. Retain evidence identifiers, source locators, calculations, and clearly labeled assumptions in the report; provide workspace-relative paths for any generated files. Use the current ILE database and workspace tools. Public-web access is unavailable. Do not fabricate facts when data cannot be retrieved.
